name: Honor Mother
overview: The Bible commands believers to honor their mother as part of the fifth commandment, promising a long and prosperous life in the land given by God (Exodus 20:12; Deuteronomy 5:16). This honor is not optional but carries serious consequences for those who curse or revile their parents, including the penalty of death (Exodus 21:17; Matthew 15:4). Scripture also emphasizes respecting and valuing a mother even in her old age (Proverbs 23:22), while highlighting the importance of parental guidance in leading children in the way of the Lord (Proverbs 22:6). Together, these passages underscore the sacred responsibility to honor and respect mothers as ordained by God.
